youtube.title: DRS SARAH AND RANDALL FARRANT
youtube.summary: Rodney and doctors Sarah and Randall Farrant discuss the vital role of gut health in overall wellbeing, highlighting its influence on the brain, immunity, and long-term health. They examine how birth methods, diet, and antibiotics shape the gut microbiome, especially in children. They also emphasise natural support through fibre-rich and fermented foods, proper hydration, and good digestion, alongside supportive practices to maintain a healthy gut. For further information: Check out their website Vital-Wellbeing Find them on Facebook , Instagram and Rumble Read the Vital-Wellbeing Blog: Brain Health Starts in the Gut Purchase Dr Sarah Farrant's The Vital Truth book and The Health Illusion book or discover more from Dr Natasha Campbell-McBride

youtube.title: IAIN DAVIS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with UK investigative journalist Iain Davis about his new book The Technocratic Dark State , in which he lays out the evidence that a network of Silicon Valley elites is advancing a post-democratic, technocratic model of governance via the second Trump Administration. Davis links the “Dark Enlightenment” philosophy to figures such as Peter Thiel and Elon Musk, warning of corporate-run ‘sovereign realms' where citizens become customers and rights are tokenised on digital ledgers. He cautions that AI-driven governance, digital ID, and special economic zones are early signs of a system that could erode liberties unless actively resisted. Please note this interview was recorded before the UK arrest of Peter Mandelson and contain references to him not having being arrested. Discover more from Iain on his website , substack and X

youtube.summary: Between clauses in the US Farm Bill and President Donald Trump's Executive Order protecting US glyphosate and phosphorous production, guest Meryl Nass suggests the pesticide industry is effectively being deregulated. The result will be that the industry has effective immunity from prosecution for related harms. Complicating things, HHS Secretary Robert Kennedy has got behind Trump's order, which has sent the Make America Healthy Again coalition that contributed to Trump's 2024 victory into a spin. youtube.title: RODNEY’S REFLECTION
youtube.summary: Rodney discusses the Epstein file revelations, questioning how powerful figures and institutions failed to protect vulnerable young women. He calls for accountability, reform, and reflection to ensure such abuses are never ignored again.

youtube.title: HRVOJE MORIC
youtube.summary: Independent journalist and podcaster Hrvoje Morić joins Paul for a discussion about the moves that are reshaping the globe in to a series of Technates – regional power blocs – that he believes will ultimately operate under one global government driven by surveillance and algocracy (rule by algorithm). Morić believes ‘the hour is late', with much of the architecture needed to do this already in place. He says a focus on local connections and parallel structures is the best defence against the advancing new world order. For more information visit Hrvoje's website Geopolitics and Empire or find him on X

youtube.title: CLAIRE BLEAKLEY
youtube.summary: In January the Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) approved the GM Purple tomato, engineered with genes from the snapdragon, into the food chain as a fresh tomato. The Office of the Gene Regulator (OGTR) approved the seeds for growing and marketing, in Australia. GE Free NZ director Claire Bleakley points out that the GM fruit has no history of safe use as there was an absence of nutritional studies to see if allergens or hidden health problems might occur over time. Approval for the release of a living viable GM would need to have approval from the EPANZ before it could be imported and sold in New Zealand. Claire also talks about a Brand New Zealand survey of cruise-ship visitors that shows strong opposition to New Zealand relaxing its rules on GMO crops and animals. For more information: GE Free NZ: Supermarkets need EPA approval to import GMO Purple Tomato into NZ GE Free NZ: International Visitors Say No to GMO Release In New Zealand – Survey

youtube.title: NICOLAS HULSCHER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with epidemiologist and McCullough Foundation administrator Nicolas Hulscher about two major red flags: a South Korean national-insurance analysis (51 million people) that found a dose-linked rise in non-Covid respiratory infections; and newly obtained data from Israel that show a cluster of severe cardiac events in 12–16-year-olds within weeks of mRNA authorisation. Follow Nic Hulscher on X or find him on Facebook

Discover more from Ethos Alliance

youtube.title: WEEKLY ROUNDUP
youtube.summary: Dieuwe De Boer and William McGimpsey inspect New Zealand election movers, including New Zealand First’s push for an English official-language bill and a referendum on Māori seats. They debate mass migration, the India free trade talks (and visa settings), and whether the revamped “golden visa” investment inflow is a net positive. The pair also welcome Auckland’s scaled-back dwelling projections and unpack Rupert Lowe’s new “Restore Britain” party.

youtube.title: MAURICE WILLIAMSON
youtube.summary: Auckland City Councillor Maurice Williamson joins Paul to discuss the government's decision to roll back housing intensification under Plan Change 120, and the public pressure that drove it.

youtube.title: THE BRENNAN BAROMETER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan backs a Green Party proposal to grant whales legal personhood in New Zealand, saying the intelligence and interconnectedness of the natural world deserve serious consideration. He then turns to the misconduct ruling against Nelson doctor Carolyn Wheeler over ivermectin, strongly criticising the the actions of the Medical Council of New Zealand and questioning pandemic-era medical guidelines, while pledging his support for the now retired doctor. For more information check out The Press: Misconduct finding against Nelson doctor prescribing ivermectin

youtube.title: ALISTAIR’S OPINION
youtube.summary: Alistair Harding warns that the Government’s planned nationally consistent flood maps could fast-track managed retreat and undermine property rights. He argues that councils may rely on implausible climate models while overlooking human-made causes of flooding, potentially devaluing homes and limiting insurance without any actual disaster. Alistair urges homeowners to examine LIM reports, question the modelling being used and demand transparency before hazard designations reshape communities and property values across New Zealand. Check out Alistair's documentary Managed Out

youtube.title: GREENWASHED MAILBAG
youtube.summary: From Sweden’s “Inner Development Goals” to questions about Supreme Court climate rulings and trade agreements, this week’s mailbag spans the philosophical to the fiercely political. Listeners challenge carbon hypocrisy, global jet-setting elites and the direction of methane and GE policy, while others offer practical rural fixes, like distilling wilding pines and buying milk straight from the farm gate. It’s a lively mix of encouragement, scepticism and sharp-eyed scrutiny of the climate narrative at home and abroad. For further information: Methane Science Accord: Emeritus Princeton physicist, Dr William Happer speaking Tour of NZ The World Inner Development Goals : Newstalk ZB: Supreme Court ruled that the Government must take anthropogenic “climate change” into account when considering oil and gas tenders MFAT: Timeline of the Agreement on Climate Change, Trade and Sustainability (ACCTS)
